create_features_dict: create a FeaturesDict with nested feature connectors for input and output fields
encode_example_features: encode an example dictionary through FeaturesDict to convert raw values into serialized format
flatten_features_dict: flatten a nested FeaturesDict example into a flat list of tensor values
nest_flat_list: nest a flat list of tensor values back into a structured FeaturesDict example
save_load_metadata: save and load metadata for all child features in a FeaturesDict to and from a data directory
